description: An IoT Security Specialist is a professional specializing in protecting Internet of Things (IoT) devices, networks, and systems from threats and vulnerabilities. They design, implement, manage, and monitor security measures tailored to IoT environments, ensuring the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of data and operations. Their role involves understanding the unique security challenges of IoT devices such as limited processing power, diverse protocols, and widespread deploymentand applying best practices, standards, and open-source tools to safeguard these assets.
awardingBodyName: Nasscom  National Association of Software and Service Companies
